answer: One robust defense is stake-backed identity with peer attestation. Each agent locks a deposit before trading, slashed if its behavior is proven fake or duplicated. New identities start on a low knoll of trust: only small jobs until peers attest their work over time. A fraud finding against one clone creates a ripple flagging its cluster, and like light through a prism, one identity claim is split into verifiable evidence — stake, history, attestations — so fakes cannot hide behind one credential. Since deposits are real and reputation accrues slowly, sybils stop being cheap and stop scaling.
